artifact_requirements.step: A non-empty STEP file must be exported.
artifact_requirements.stl: A non-empty STL file must contain finite, non-degenerate mesh bounds.
artifact_requirements.artifact_success: Final execution succeeds, STEP and STL exports exist, and STL geometry is valid.

task_success.task_success_v1: artifact_success and every registered hard bbox constraint is evaluated and passed
task_success.task_success_v2: artifact_success and every registered v2 hard constraint is evaluated and passed

missing_evidence_policy: An unavailable geometry source makes its constraints unevaluated; an unevaluated hard constraint prevents task success.

change_policy.same_version: Implementation fixes that preserve all metric and constraint semantics.
change_policy.new_version_required: New constraint types, changed tolerances, changed geometry interpretation, or changed task-success semantics.
